definitions.explanation: With the top and bottom reversed.
In the opposite direction or order.

{逆|さか}さま⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{持|も}っていますよ→持つ：00478_motsu⟧。
⟦{物事|ものごと}→物事：00291_monogoto⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{逆|さか}さ⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{考|かんが}えてみる→考える：00856_kangaeru⟧。
examples.english: Try thinking about things in reverse.

notes:
{逆|さか}さ means upside down or reversed. Often used with the variant form {逆|さか}さま.

FORMS:
- {逆|さか}さ (noun/no-adjective)
- {逆|さか}さま (noun/na-adjective - more common)
- {逆|さか}さに (adverbially)

COMMON PATTERNS:
- {逆|さか}さになる (to become upside down)
- {逆|さか}さにする (to turn upside down)
- {逆|さか}さまに{持|も}つ (to hold upside down)

COLLOCATIONS:
- {逆|さか}さ{吊|づ}り (hanging upside down)
- {逆|さか}さ{言葉|ことば} (words said in reverse order)

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {逆|さか}さ vs. {逆|ぎゃく}: {逆|ぎゃく} means "opposite" or "reverse" in general; {逆|さか}さ specifically means physical inversion (upside down).

Register: Neutral. Common in everyday conversation.
